# Terrain interoperability fixture

This frozen version-1 fixture was generated by the original Terrarium-based
`faa-regs` producer. The current builder reads USGS GeoTIFFs and preserves the same
archive format. These files remain a compatibility regression for the consumer;
current GeoTIFF conversion and update detection are tested in `faa-regs/test/terrain.test.ts`.

The tiny region is `[-122.01, 37.01, -122.009, 37.011]`. Every native tile has
123.5 metres, -0.25 metres, and transparent nodata in its first three pixels,
followed by zero metres. The producer packages all native zooms 1–13 without
rounding away the float32 heights used by the renderer. This fixture is synthetic.
